producer_report.summary: Added the auditor role and `athena audit [JOB]`, and fixed the stale max_concurrency drain test. The auditor judges a job's real outcome against BRIEF.md and the owner's goals. It is given BRIEF.md in its brief, an OUTCOME.md (request and how the job ended) and the files the job changed as they stood in its commit. It is not given the job's acceptance criteria or any other record about the job. Its report is a summary plus findings, each with `text` and `evidence`. A finding with no evidence refuses the whole report, but the paid invocation is still recorded. A good report is committed as a new `athena.audit/1` record at `records/audits/<YYYY-MM>/<id>.json`, with the auditor's invocation and role definition. `athena audit` prints the findings, the invocation record path, model, outcome and cost, and `athena status` shows the latest audit. Role::Auditor round-trips through parse/as_str, and the fake driver, store, context budget and test scenario handle it. The prompt-protection caveat (fixed constant only, warden request will enforce it, prose-only) is in the AUDITOR_PROMPT doc comment, the auditor.rs module comment, roles-and-ladder.md and CHANGELOG.md. Root cause of the drain test: it replaced the text `max_concurrency = 2`, but athena.toml now says `= 1`, so `before` and `after` were equal. The test now replaces the real value (`max_concurrency = 1`) with 2 and 3. It first asserts that value is still in the config, so the same drift fails with a clear message. athena.toml is unchanged. `cargo test --locked`, clippy with `-D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass.

open_issues: The auditor's prompt is protected only by being a constant; nothing checks it. The warden request must enforce it. This is marked prose-only.
The auditor reuses the verifier's model and budget, as the steward and audience do; an auditor-specific model and budget is not added.
Only the 40 first changed files, each capped at 60,000 characters, are given to the auditor.
The auditor was exercised only with the fake driver; no live model run.
mistakes: I used a Grep call with both a path and a mismatched glob first, which returned nothing; no effect on the result.
I added docs/records.md, which is not in the deliverable list; it is one line listing the new record's location, to keep docs matching the code.
learnings: Existing roles with a record kind (steward, audience) are wired through store.rs, which routes their invocations to `*_runs` vectors rather than `jobs`; the auditor follows that.
The workspace has two binaries (athena, xtask), so `cargo run -- <args>` fails without `--bin athena`.
athena.toml has `max_concurrency = 1`; the drain test used to hard-code a replacement of `= 2`.
Role matches in the fake driver, in run_pin_tests.rs and in the CLI test helper are exhaustive, so adding a role breaks the build until each handles it.
desires: Bash allows no read of tool-result files outside the working directory, so a long `cargo test` output could not be searched after the fact; I reran with `-q`.
A `default-run` for the workspace, so `cargo run -- audit --help` works as the criterion words it.
